pageTitle: Celebrate Lantern Rite and Take Part in the Events to Win Primogems
name: Celebrate Lantern Rite and Take Part in the Events to Win Primogems
description: Olah! Hello, Travelers~ Another year, another Lantern Rite. On this beautiful day, are you also having a pleasant Lantern Rite while wandering around Teyvat? On this journey, do you have any great stories that you are willing to tell me? Share your Lantern Rite memories for a chance to obtain Primogems!
